title: Digest is superseded
statement: A component digest is superseded when its lifecycle holds a supersession.

title: Digest is past its fail date
statement: A component digest is past its fail date when its lifecycle holds a supersession or a withdrawal, and the date after which it fails has passed.

title: Digest is withdrawn
statement: A component digest is withdrawn when its lifecycle holds a withdrawal, whatever the date of the withdrawal.

title: Generated file is hand-edited
statement: A generated file is hand-edited when the file on disk is missing or no longer matches the hash its record holds.

title: Component fit for a golden path
statement: A component is fit for a golden path when its stage is ga. An archetype or a mixin MUST NOT include a component that is not.

title: Port has one provider
statement: A port has one provider when exactly one component of the active component set provides it. Each port MUST have one provider in the active set.

title: Every required port is answered
statement: An active component set answers its ports when every port that a component of the set requires has a provider in that set.

title: Component past its sunset
statement: A component is past its sunset when its stage is alpha or beta and its sunset date is earlier than today.
